senses.en: a person who prepares and sells medicines; a pharmacist (chiefly North American)

example.en: The druggist explained how to take the medicine.
example.zh: 药剂师说明了这种药的服用方法。

senses.en: to make someone feel uneasy or embarrassed

example.en: His blunt questions discomfited the panel.
example.zh: 他直截了当的提问让评审团很窘迫。

senses.en: to hide one's true feelings from others; to pretend

example.en: He dissimulated his fear behind a calm smile.
example.zh: 他用平静的微笑掩饰自己的恐惧。

senses.en: able to be tolerated or borne

example.en: The pain was severe but endurable.
example.zh: 疼痛虽然剧烈，但仍能忍受。

senses.en: an invented international language based mainly on European languages

example.en: She learned Esperanto so she could write to friends around the world.
example.zh: 她学习世界语，以便能给世界各地的朋友写信。

senses.en: (dated, British) a woman hired to clean houses, especially by the day
senses.zh: （旧时英式英语）打杂女工；按日雇用的清洁女佣

example.en: The old lady worked as a charwoman in the offices nearby.
example.zh: 老太太在附近的办公室当打杂女工。

senses.en: describing a verb that does not take a direct object

example.en: In the sentence 'She smiled', the verb 'smiled' is intransitive.
example.zh: 在“She smiled”这个句子里，动词“smiled”是不及物的。

senses.en: a verb that does not take a direct object

example.en: 'Arrive' is an intransitive in English.
example.zh: 在英语中，“arrive”是不及物动词。

senses.en: a group of people who attend to and follow an important person

example.en: The movie star arrived with a large entourage.
example.zh: 那位电影明星带着大批随行人员到场。

senses.en: to happen or become real; to appear unexpectedly

example.en: Our plans never materialised.
example.zh: 我们的计划从未实现。

senses.en: an act that breaks a rule, law, or agreement
senses.zh: 违反规则、法律或协议的行为

example.en: The court found a violation of the contract.
example.zh: 法院认定存在违反合同的行为。

senses.en: a minor offense, especially a traffic or parking offense
senses.zh: 轻微违法行为（尤指交通或停车违章）

example.en: A ticket was issued for a parking violation.
example.zh: 因停车违章开出了一张罚单。

senses.en: to teach children or adults, especially in a school or program

example.en: The program educates adults who did not finish school.
example.zh: 该项目为没有完成学业的成年人提供教育。

senses.en: to help someone learn about something or develop good judgment

example.en: Good teachers educate students to think for themselves.
example.zh: 好老师培养学生独立思考。

senses.en: a regular payment made to someone who has retired from work

example.en: She receives a pension every month after retiring from the company.
example.zh: 她从公司退休后每个月领取养老金。

senses.en: to pay someone a pension, usually when they retire
senses.zh: 发放退休金；准予退休并领养老金

example.en: The company pensioned him off after thirty years of service.
example.zh: 公司在他工作三十年后让他退休并发放退休金。

senses.en: based on or supporting democracy and social equality
senses.zh: 民主的；基于民主原则的

example.en: Citizens took part in a peaceful democratic election.
example.zh: 公民参加了和平的民主选举。

senses.en: relating to the Democratic Party in the United States

example.en: She voted for the Democratic candidate in the local election.
example.zh: 她在地方选举中投票给了民主党候选人。

senses.en: the act of putting money or capital into a business or project to make a profit
senses.zh: 为获利而把资金投入企业或项目的行动

example.en: The firm made a major investment in clean energy.
example.zh: 该公司在清洁能源上进行了重大投资。

senses.en: money or property that is invested to earn a profit
senses.zh: 为获利而投入的资金或财产

example.en: She saw her education as an investment in the future.
example.zh: 她把教育视为对未来的投资。

senses.en: Having a husband or wife; joined in marriage.

example.en: They have been married for ten years.
example.zh: 他们已经结婚十年了。

senses.en: Relating to marriage or married people.

example.en: She is writing a book about married life.
example.zh: 她正在写一本关于婚姻生活的书。

senses.en: having the same amount, value, or status as another
senses.zh: （数量、价值或地位）相等的；平等的

example.en: All students should have equal opportunities to learn.
example.zh: 所有学生都应享有平等的学习机会。

senses.en: to be the same as or match something

example.en: Her salary equals mine.
example.zh: 她的工资和我的一样。

senses.en: a person of the same status or ability as another

example.en: As a writer, she has few equals.
example.zh: 作为作家，她少有匹敌者。

senses.en: to put a plan, decision, or system into effect

example.en: The school will implement the new policy next month.
example.zh: 学校将于下个月实施新政策。

senses.en: a tool or piece of equipment used for a particular task

example.en: Farmers use simple implements to work the soil.
example.zh: 农民使用简单的工具耕作土壤。

senses.en: to pull a vehicle or object behind another using a rope or chain

example.en: The truck towed the broken car to the repair shop.
example.zh: 卡车把坏掉的车拖到了修理厂。

senses.en: the act of pulling a vehicle or object behind another

example.en: My car broke down, so I called for a tow.
example.zh: 我的车抛锚了，所以我叫了拖车。

senses.en: a member of the order of mammals that includes monkeys, apes, and humans

example.en: Monkeys, apes, and humans are all primates.
example.zh: 猴子、猿和人类都属于灵长类。

senses.en: a senior archbishop or bishop in some Christian churches

example.en: The primate of the church led the ceremony.
example.zh: 该教会的大主教主持了仪式。

senses.en: the number 0; nothing

example.en: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
example.zh: 昨晚气温降到了零度。

senses.en: the figure 0

example.en: Write zero in the ones place.
example.zh: 在个位写零。

senses.en: to set an instrument or aim to zero

example.en: The pilots zeroed in on the target.
example.zh: 飞行员将目标锁定在瞄准点上。

senses.en: having none; no amount at all

example.en: The project made zero progress this week.
example.zh: 这个项目本周毫无进展。

senses.en: not interesting; making you feel tired and impatient

example.en: The lecture was so boring that several students fell asleep.
example.zh: 这堂课太无聊了，好几个学生都睡着了。

senses.en: the act of drilling a hole, especially in the ground for oil or samples

example.en: The boring of the tunnel took nearly two years.
example.zh: 隧道的钻掘花了将近两年。

senses.en: legal actions taken through a court (usually plural)

example.en: They started divorce proceedings last month.
example.zh: 他们上个月提起了离婚诉讼。

senses.en: the written record of a meeting or conference

example.en: Her paper appeared in the conference proceedings.
example.zh: 她的论文发表在会议论文集中。

senses.en: a set of methods and principles used in a particular field of study or activity

example.en: The paper explains the research methodology in detail.
example.zh: 论文详细解释了研究方法。

senses.en: an organism such as a mushroom or mold that has no chlorophyll and feeds on organic matter

example.en: The damp basement wall was covered with a white fungus.
example.zh: 潮湿的地下室墙壁上长满了白色真菌。

senses.en: to build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed

example.en: The city plans to reconstruct the old bridge.
example.zh: 该市计划重建那座旧桥。

senses.en: to form an idea of what happened by putting evidence together

example.en: Police reconstructed the events of that night from witness statements.
example.zh: 警方根据目击者陈述还原了当晚的事件。

senses.en: one of two lines of latitude about 23.5 degrees north or south of the equator
senses.zh: 回归线（北回归线或南回归线）

example.en: The Tropic of Cancer passes through southern China.
example.zh: 北回归线穿过中国南部。

senses.en: (the tropics) the hot region between the two tropic lines

example.en: Many unusual birds live in the tropics.
example.zh: 许多奇特的鸟类生活在热带地区。

senses.en: a person who kills someone by strangling
senses.zh: 扼杀者；勒死他人的凶手

example.en: The detective finally caught the strangler after months of investigation.
example.zh: 经过数月的调查，侦探终于抓获了那个勒杀犯。

senses.en: a plant, such as a fig, that grows around a host tree and eventually kills it
senses.zh: 绞杀植物（缠绕并绞死宿主树的植物）

example.en: A strangler fig slowly wrapped itself around the old tree.
example.zh: 一棵绞杀榕慢慢缠绕住了那棵老树。

senses.en: merely; no more than

example.en: I only wanted to ask a question.
example.zh: 我只是想问一个问题。

senses.en: single of its kind; with no others

example.en: She is the only person I trust.
example.zh: 她是我唯一信任的人。

senses.en: but; except that

example.en: You can go, only please come back early.
example.zh: 你可以去，只是请早点回来。

senses.en: measuring little in length or distance; not long

example.en: The line at the bank was surprisingly short.
example.zh: 银行的队伍出奇地短。

senses.en: lasting only a small amount of time

example.en: We had a short meeting before lunch.
example.zh: 我们在午饭前开了个简短的会议。

senses.en: a sudden failure in an electrical circuit caused by wires touching

example.en: A short in the wiring caused the lights to go out.
example.zh: 线路短路导致灯熄灭了。

senses.en: to make a short circuit happen

example.en: Water got into the outlet and shorted the circuit.
example.zh: 水进入插座，使电路短路了。

senses.en: to defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest

example.en: Our team beat them by two points.
example.zh: 我们队以两分的优势战胜了他们。

senses.en: to hit something repeatedly

example.en: She beat the drum with two sticks.
example.zh: 她用两根鼓槌敲鼓。

senses.en: a regular pulse or rhythmic sound

example.en: He tapped his foot to the beat of the music.
example.zh: 他随着音乐的节拍轻踏脚。

senses.en: very tired; informal

example.en: After the long walk, I was beat.
example.zh: 走了很长一段路后，我累坏了。

senses.en: to know someone or something again because you have seen or heard them before

example.en: I recognised her voice on the phone immediately.
example.zh: 我在电话里立刻听出了她的声音。

senses.en: to accept that something is true, valid, or important

example.en: The government recognised the new state last year.
example.zh: 政府去年承认了这个新国家。

senses.en: to show approval or appreciation of someone's work or achievement

example.en: The company recognised her contribution with an award.
example.zh: 公司以奖项表彰了她的贡献。

senses.en: a person who takes photographs, especially as a profession

example.en: The photographer took pictures of the wedding guests.
example.zh: 摄影师为婚礼宾客拍照。

senses.en: a container with a handle and spout used for pouring liquids

example.en: She poured lemonade from the pitcher into the glasses.
example.zh: 她把柠檬水从水罐倒进杯子里。

senses.en: in baseball, the player who throws the ball to the batter

example.en: The pitcher threw a fast ball to strike out the batter.
example.zh: 投手投出一记快速球，三振了击球手。

senses.en: a collection of things gathered together as a whole

example.en: The site offers an aggregation of news from many sources.
example.zh: 该网站汇集了来自许多来源的新闻。

senses.en: a wide wall of earth or stone built to protect a place

example.en: Soldiers patrolled along the ramparts of the old fortress.
example.zh: 士兵们沿着一座古堡的壁垒巡逻。

senses.en: a deep crack, especially in a glacier or in an embankment

example.en: The climbers carefully crossed the crevasse in the glacier.
example.zh: 登山者小心翼翼地穿过冰川上的裂隙。

senses.en: the hard outer covering of a bird's egg

example.en: The chicks hatched, leaving behind empty eggshells in the nest.
example.zh: 小鸡孵出来了，窝里留下空蛋壳。

senses.en: to commit a crime or harmful act

example.en: The police caught the men who perpetrated the fraud.
example.zh: 警方抓获了实施诈骗的人。

senses.en: making you feel calm and rested

example.en: We spent a relaxing weekend at the lake.
example.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一个轻松的周末。

senses.en: to shout loudly in a deep voice, like a bull

example.en: The coach bellowed at the players to run faster.
example.zh: 教练大声吼着让队员们跑快些。

senses.en: to make a loud deep cry, as an animal does

example.en: The bull bellowed loudly in the field.
example.zh: 公牛在田野里大声吼叫。

senses.en: a very loud, deep shout or cry

example.en: We heard a bellow of anger from the next room.
example.zh: 我们听到隔壁房间传来愤怒的吼声。

senses.en: a person treated as especially important (abbreviation of very important person; usually written VIP)
senses.zh: 贵宾；要人（very important person 的缩写，通常写作 VIP）

example.en: A separate entrance was reserved for each VIP.
example.zh: 每位贵宾均可使用专用入口。

senses.en: the strength or power to produce an effect

example.en: The drug loses potency after its expiration date.
example.zh: 药物过期后会失去效力。

senses.en: dull and lacking colour or brightness

example.en: They lived in a drab little apartment.
example.zh: 他们住在一间单调乏味的小公寓里。

senses.en: to know the meaning of words or something said or written
senses.zh: 懂得；理解（话语或文字的意思）

example.en: She didn't understand the question.
example.zh: 她没听懂这个问题。

senses.en: to know how or why something works or happens
senses.zh: 了解；明白（某事如何或为何发生）

example.en: I understand how the engine works.
example.zh: 我了解这台发动机如何运转。

senses.en: to believe or be told that something is true

example.en: I understand that the meeting has been moved.
example.zh: 我听说会议已经改期。

senses.en: to be sympathetic to someone's feelings or situation
senses.zh: 体谅；理解（某人的感受或处境）

example.en: She understands what you're going through.
example.zh: 她理解你正在经历的事。

senses.en: to have enough money or time for something
senses.zh: 有足够的钱或时间做某事；负担得起

example.en: We can't afford a new car this year.
example.zh: 今年我们买不起新车。

senses.en: to provide or make something available

example.en: The balcony affords a clear view of the mountains.
example.zh: 阳台可以看到清晰的山景。

senses.en: the job of looking after someone or something

example.en: The children are in her care.
example.zh: 孩子们由她照顾。

senses.en: to feel that something is important or worrying

example.en: She cares deeply about animals.
example.zh: 她非常关心动物。

senses.en: a feeling of worry or responsibility

example.en: Money is her only care.
example.zh: 钱是她唯一操心的事。

senses.en: to look after someone, especially a sick or old person

example.en: He cares for his sick mother at home.
example.zh: 他在家照顾生病的母亲。

senses.en: an agreement or arrangement, especially in business

example.en: The two companies signed a new deal.
example.zh: 两家公司签署了一项新协议。

senses.en: to take action to solve or handle something

example.en: We must deal with this problem quickly.
example.zh: 我们必须尽快处理这个问题。

senses.en: a large amount or quantity

example.en: She spent a great deal of time on the project.
example.zh: 她在这个项目上花了大量时间。

senses.en: to give out cards to players in a game

example.en: It is your turn to deal the cards.
example.zh: 轮到你发牌了。

senses.en: very complicated, with many small connected parts

example.en: The watch has an intricate design with hundreds of tiny parts.
example.zh: 这块手表设计复杂，有数百个微小的零件。

senses.en: the act of copying someone or something's behavior or style

example.en: Children learn a lot through imitation of their parents.
example.zh: 孩子通过模仿父母学到很多东西。

senses.en: a copy of something real, often not genuine

example.en: This watch is an imitation, not the real brand.
example.zh: 这块手表是仿制品，不是正品。

senses.en: artificial; made to look like something real

example.en: She bought an imitation fur coat.
example.zh: 她买了一件仿皮草外套。

senses.en: the state of being ill; disease or poor health

example.en: She stayed home because of sickness.
example.zh: 她因为生病待在家里。

senses.en: the feeling of needing to vomit, especially from travel or pregnancy

example.en: Motion sickness made the long bus ride unpleasant.
example.zh: 晕车让长途巴士旅程很不舒服。

senses.en: a close-fitting garment covering the foot and leg, usually worn by women

example.en: She bought a new pair of stockings to wear with her dress.
example.zh: 她买了一双新的长袜来搭配她的裙子。

senses.en: a large sock-like bag that children hang up at Christmas for gifts

example.en: The children hung their stockings by the fireplace on Christmas Eve.
example.zh: 孩子们在平安夜把圣诞袜挂在壁炉边。

senses.en: the state of being able to be used or obtained

example.en: Check the availability of tickets before you travel.
example.zh: 出行前请确认车票是否还有。

senses.en: the state of being free to meet or be contacted, or of a time slot being open

example.en: Please confirm your availability for the meeting.
example.zh: 请确认您是否有空参加会议。

senses.en: (computing) the degree to which a system is accessible and operational

example.en: The service guarantees high availability for its users.
example.zh: 该服务保证为用户提供高可用性。

senses.en: needing immediate attention or action

example.en: She received an urgent phone call from the hospital.
example.zh: 她接到医院打来的紧急电话。

senses.en: to become or make something greater, worse, or more intense

example.en: The conflict could escalate into a full war.
example.zh: 冲突可能升级为全面战争。

senses.en: a person who actively supports or publicizes something

example.en: She is a strong promoter of healthy eating.
example.zh: 她是健康饮食的积极倡导者。

senses.en: a person who organizes and stages public events or entertainments
senses.zh: （演出、赛事等的）主办者；承办人

example.en: The concert promoter arranged the venue and tickets.
example.zh: 演唱会主办者安排了场地和票务。

senses.en: to agree with someone or something

example.en: The committee concurred with the final decision.
example.zh: 委员会同意最终决定。

senses.en: to happen at the same time

example.en: The two events concurred on the same evening.
example.zh: 两件事在同一个晚上同时发生。

senses.en: to gather a large amount of money, objects, or power over time

example.en: He amassed a large fortune through careful investing.
example.zh: 他通过谨慎投资积累了大量财富。

senses.en: (British) a meal bought at a restaurant and taken away to eat, or a shop selling such food
senses.zh: 外卖食品；外卖餐馆（英式）

example.en: We ordered a Chinese takeaway for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚饭订了一份中式外卖。

senses.en: (especially North American) a key point or lesson learned from a discussion, meeting, etc.

example.en: The main takeaway from the meeting was the need to cut costs.
example.zh: 这次会议的主要启示是需要削减成本。

senses.en: the dishes, utensils and glassware used for serving and eating meals

example.en: They bought elegant tableware for the new apartment.
example.zh: 他们为新居买了精美的餐具。

senses.en: to take private property away, especially by a government or authority

example.en: The government may expropriate land for a public project.
example.zh: 政府可为公共项目征用土地。

senses.en: a woman who is a member of the police

example.en: A policewoman directed traffic at the busy intersection.
example.zh: 一名女警察在繁忙的十字路口指挥交通。

senses.en: lazy; not wanting to work or make effort

example.en: He spent an indolent afternoon doing nothing.
example.zh: 他懒散地度过了一个无所事事的下午。

senses.en: (medical) slow to develop and usually painless

example.en: The tumor was indolent and slow-growing.
example.zh: 肿瘤是无痛且生长缓慢的。

senses.en: shining or burning unsteadily

example.en: A flickering candle lit the dark room.
example.zh: 一支摇曳的蜡烛照亮了黑暗的房间。

senses.en: a small hole made by a sharp object, especially in a tire

example.en: A nail caused a puncture in my front tire.
example.zh: 一颗钉子把我前轮胎扎了个孔。

senses.en: to make a small hole in something with a pointed object

example.en: He punctured the lid of the can with a sharp knife.
example.zh: 他用锋利的刀子在罐头盖上扎了个孔。

senses.en: to occupy someone's complete attention

example.en: The novel engrossed her for the entire weekend.
example.zh: 这部小说让她整个周末都全神贯注。

senses.en: flat containers used for serving or holding food

example.en: Please wash the dishes after dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭后请把盘子洗了。

senses.en: foods that are prepared in a particular way

example.en: The restaurant serves dishes from many countries.
example.zh: 这家餐厅供应来自许多国家的菜肴。

senses.en: to equip a process or industry with machines so that work is done mechanically

example.en: The farm decided to mechanise its harvesting operations.
example.zh: 农场决定使收割作业机械化。

senses.en: to make something automatic, routine or monotonous

example.en: Critics say the system has mechanised the learning process.
example.zh: 批评者认为该制度使学习过程变得刻板。

senses.en: officials who make sure players follow the rules in sports

example.en: The referee stopped the game after the injury.
example.zh: 裁判在有人受伤后中止了比赛。

senses.en: to act as the referee in a game or competition

example.en: He refereed the final match last year.
example.zh: 他去年执法了决赛。

senses.en: people who give a judgement on someone's work or ability

example.en: The paper was sent to two referees for review.
example.zh: 这篇论文被送交两位审稿人评审。

senses.en: instruments or devices used to do work

example.en: He keeps his tools in a red box.
example.zh: 他把工具放在一个红色箱子里。

senses.en: things that help you achieve something, such as software or methods

example.en: The app is a useful tool for learning vocabulary.
example.zh: 这款应用是学习词汇的实用工具。
